/\ IF phase = "ready" /\ req[r].sid = sid
       THEN /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![r] = [@ EXCEPT !.st = "resuming", !.resumes = @ + 1, !.stream = TRUE]]
new:
/\ IF phase = "ready"
       THEN /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![r] = [@ EXCEPT !.st = "resuming", !.resumes = @ + 1, !.stream = TRUE]]

description: Close sends a DELETE while a new session is starting, naming the ended one
